baseline.name: FlashInfer
baseline.release_state: latest stable GitHub release; v0.6.17 was RC/nightly at measurement time

measurement.name: eager_stream_batch_cuda_event
measurement.definition: CUDA event interval around 100 sequential provider calls on one stream, divided by 100
measurement.fixture_match: operand BF16 bit-pattern digests match across both providers and both orders
measurement.included_caveat: GPU idle gaps caused by eager host submission remain inside the event interval; this is not isolated kernel duration or CUDA Graph performance
measurement.loom_path: immutable plans and checked command scopes with fixed bindings
measurement.flashinfer_gemm_path: prepared CublasltBf16GemmRunner with fixed tactic 0, output, and workspace
measurement.loom_decode_execution: KV length 1 uses one direct kernel; KV lengths 33, 127, and 4096 use one split-K partial kernel plus one stable F32 merge kernel
measurement.execution_metadata: each raw record retains algorithm, partition count, workspace, and kernels per provider call

contracts.rms_norm: contiguous BF16 [rows,hidden], F32 accumulation, epsilon 1e-5, preallocated output
contracts.gemm: BF16 D[M,N]=A[M,K]*W[N,K]^T, M=1,N=4096,K=4096, BF16 output, explicit cuBLASLt tactic 0
contracts.single_decode: BF16 Q/O [query_heads,128], K/V NHD [kv_len,kv_heads,128], full window, no positional encoding or soft cap, F32 state, returned LSE

rmsnorm_flashinfer_exclusion.reason: unmodified FlashInfer 0.6.16.post1 RMSNorm JIT failed under CUDA 13.1.115 before measurement
rmsnorm_flashinfer_exclusion.compiler_error: fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope.cuh:469: ambiguous const int64_t % const flashinfer::IntFastDiv
rmsnorm_flashinfer_exclusion.official_cubin_asset_result: not installed because the 1.06 GB release asset transferred at approximately 8 KB/s on the validation host

accepted_claims: matched BF16 operand bit patterns, shapes, layouts, preallocated buffers, CUDA events, and both provider orders were used on one H20
split-K lowers Loom median eager-provider latency by 1.65x at MQA KV-length-33, 3.79x at GQA KV-length-127, and 26.79x at GQA KV-length-4096 versus the recorded pre-split-K Loom source
FlashInfer retains 1.26x lower median latency at MQA KV-length-33, 1.69x at GQA KV-length-127, and 3.00x at GQA KV-length-4096 under the declared eager metric
Loom retains lower median eager-provider latency for MHA KV-length-1 and the fixed M=1 cuBLASLt GEMM case, subject to the declared short-path order variance
raw samples, execution metadata, per-order medians, percentile ranges, and fixture digests are retained
excluded_claims: high-precision ranking for short eager paths whose provider order delta exceeds five percent
performance on GPUs other than the declared H20
